@Roth.index_le_Θ : ∀ {σ : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype σ] {B : ℝ} {q r : σ → ℕ} {R : MvPolynomial σ ℤ},
  R ∈ Roth.RSet B r →
    ∀ {h : σ → ℤ},
      (∀ (j : σ), IsCoprime (h j) ↑(q j)) →
        Roth.index ((map (Int.castRingHom ℝ)) R) (fun j ↦ ↑(h j) / ↑(q j)) r ≤ Roth.Θ B q r

theorem Roth.index_le_Θ.{u_1} : ∀ {σ : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype σ] {B : ℝ} {q r : σ → ℕ} {R : MvPolynomial σ ℤ},
  R ∈ Roth.RSet B r →
    ∀ {h : σ → ℤ},
      (∀ (j : σ), IsCoprime (h j) ↑(q j)) →
        Roth.index ((map (Int.castRingHom ℝ)) R) (fun j ↦ ↑(h j) / ↑(q j)) r ≤ Roth.Θ B q r :=
fun {σ} [Fintype σ] {B} {q r} {R} hR {h} hh ↦
  le_csSup (Roth.indexSet_bddAbove B q) (Exists.intro R ⟨hR, Exists.intro h ⟨hh, rfl⟩⟩)

INDEXLETHETA187_FULL_TYPE: ∀ {σ : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype σ] {B : ℝ} {q r : σ → ℕ} {R : MvPolynomial σ ℤ},
  R ∈ Roth.RSet B r →
    ∀ {h : σ → ℤ},
      (∀ (j : σ), IsCoprime (h j) ↑(q j)) →
        Roth.index ((map (Int.castRingHom ℝ)) R) (fun (j : σ) ↦ ↑(h j) / ↑(q j)) r ≤ Roth.Θ B q r
